Multi-Head Attention linearly projects queries, keys, and values h times into distinct learned subspaces, enabling the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces simultaneously.

question: Explain why knowledge graph schema-constrained agents prevent hallucinations on unanswerable or counterfactual research queries, whereas Direct LLMs and flat Vector RAG produce spurious responses.

Standard Vector RAG retrieves top-k chunks with high lexical or cosine similarity and conditions the generator on out-of-context text, leading the LLM to hallucinate connective facts between fragmented passages. In contrast, a schema-constrained KG agent verifies whether valid entity nodes and explicit schema relation edges exist in the knowledge graph; when no grounded relation path connects the query entities, the agent truthfully abstains with 100% precision, preventing false scientific claims.
Direct LLMs and Vector RAG hallucinate plausible text when facts are absent, whereas schema-constrained KG agents check for verified ontology paths and safely abstain when no semantic relation exists
Knowledge graph agents verify explicit relational paths and truthfully abstain on unanswerable questions, eliminating parametric hallucinations
